Catalog.Name: Street
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 VP per building next to your Streets. Count each building once.

Catalog.Name: House
Catalog.Rules: Place: +1 VP per adjacent Home building. Payout: +1 coin if a Shop is within 2 tiles.

Catalog.Name: Cottage
Catalog.Rules: Place: +1 VP per adjacent park tile or Lake. Payout: +1 coin if adjacent to a park tile or Lake.

Catalog.Name: Shop
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 coin per Home building within 2 tiles, max 3.

Catalog.Name: Farm
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 coin if adjacent to another Farm or Orchard.

Catalog.Name: Park
Catalog.Rules: Park size 1. Place: gain the extra VP this tile adds to the park score.

Catalog.Name: Wild Garden
Catalog.Rules: Park size 1. Place: gain the extra VP this tile adds to the park score.

Catalog.Name: Grant
Catalog.Rules: Play: gain 4 coins, then discard this card.

Catalog.Name: Avenue
Catalog.Rules: Counts as 2 road tiles for Longest Road. Payout: +1 coin if adjacent to at least 2 buildings.

Catalog.Name: Roundabout
Catalog.Rules: Gain 1 VP whenever anyone places an adjacent building.

Catalog.Name: Orchard
Catalog.Rules: Park size 1. Place: gain the extra VP this tile adds to the park score. Payout: +1 coin if adjacent to a Farm or another Orchard.

Catalog.Name: Lake
Catalog.Rules: Payout: each adjacent Home building earns its owner 1 coin. Satisfies park adjacency effects. Adds no park size and does not connect parks.

Catalog.Name: Vineyard
Catalog.Rules: Payout: 0 coins for the first 2 payouts, then +3 coins each payout.

Catalog.Name: Startup
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 coin, then +2 coins, then +3 coins each payout.

Catalog.Name: Market
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 coin per Shop you own within 2 tiles, max 4.

Catalog.Name: Contractor
Catalog.Rules: Gain 1 coin when you build a House or Shop, max 2 per round.

Catalog.Name: Apartment
Catalog.Rules: Place: +2 VP per adjacent Home building. Payout: +2 coins if a Shop is within 2 tiles.

Catalog.Name: Cafe
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 coin per adjacent Home building or Shop, max 3. End: +2 VP if adjacent to a park tile or Lake.

Catalog.Name: Fountain
Catalog.Rules: Park size 2. Place: gain the extra VP this tile adds to the park score.

Catalog.Name: Factory
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +2 coins. End: each adjacent Home building or Cafe loses its owner 1 VP, including yours.

Catalog.Name: Sapling
Catalog.Rules: Park size 1. Place: gain the extra VP this tile adds to the park score. After its second payout, grows to size 3. Gain any extra park VP from this growth.

Catalog.Name: Bank
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +2 coins.

Catalog.Name: Town Hall
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +2 coins if you own at least 3 Civic buildings, including this.

Catalog.Name: Museum
Catalog.Rules: End: +1 VP per other Culture building you own, max 8.

Catalog.Name: Chamber of Commerce
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 coin per 2 Trade buildings you own, including this, max 4 coins.

Catalog.Name: Warehouse
Catalog.Rules: Round start: gain a Street if your hand has room. Gain 1 coin for your first Street each round.

Catalog.Name: Builders' Yard
Catalog.Rules: Round start: gain a Street or random Common card if your hand has room. Choose before the round starts.

Catalog.Name: Hospital
Catalog.Rules: Each round: one random Home building has an emergency. The nearest Hospital within 4 tiles earns its owner 1 VP. Ties go to the Hospital built first.

Catalog.Name: Tourist Office
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 coin per Culture building you own, including this, max 3.

Catalog.Name: Tax Office
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 coin per 4 Home buildings you own.

Catalog.Name: Depot
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 coin per 5 road tiles you own, max 4 coins.

Catalog.Name: School
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 coin per Home building you own within 2 tiles, max 4.

Catalog.Name: Granary
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 coin per Farm or Orchard you own, max 3.

Catalog.Name: Stadium
Catalog.Rules: Payout: each adjacent Home building earns its owner 1 coin; each adjacent Cafe loses its owner 1 coin. End: +1 VP per adjacent Home building.

Catalog.Name: Airport
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +3 coins. End: each Home building within 2 tiles loses its owner 1 VP. Maximum loss: 3 VP per player across all Airports.

Catalog.Name: Skyscraper
Catalog.Rules: Requires at least 2 adjacent buildings. End: +1 VP per other building within 2 tiles, max 6.

Catalog.Name: Industrial Estate
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 coin per Industry building you own, including this, max 5.

Catalog.Name: Housing Authority
Catalog.Rules: End: +1 VP per 3 Home buildings you own, including this, max 6.

Catalog.Name: Eco Council
Catalog.Rules: End: +1 VP per 2 Nature buildings you own, including this, max 8. Subtract 2 VP per Industry building you own. This bonus cannot fall below 0.

Catalog.Name: Gardener's Guild
Catalog.Rules: Gain 1 coin when you build a park tile.

Catalog.Name: Architect's Studio
Catalog.Rules: Gain 2 coins if your first building this round is adjacent to one of your tiles. Can trigger when you build this.

Catalog.Name: Renovation
Catalog.Rules: Play: replace one of your buildings with a different building card from your hand. Discard both cards.

Catalog.Name: Ribbon Cutting
Catalog.Rules: Play: gain 1 coin per building you built this round, max 4. Discard this card.

Catalog.Name: Rush Hour
Catalog.Rules: Play: gain 1 extra coin per Shop you own at the next payout, max 4. Once per round. Discard this card.

Catalog.Name: Land Claim
Catalog.Rules: Play: reserve an empty tile until the next round starts. Only you may build there. Discard this card.

Catalog.Name: Central Station
Catalog.Rules: Payout: +1 coin per Shop or Market you own, max 4.

Catalog.Name: Senate
Catalog.Rules: End: +2 VP for each tag shared by at least 3 of your buildings, max 12. Counts this building.

Catalog.Name: Monument
Catalog.Rules: End: +6 VP.
